title: Governed GPT Admin Staging readiness remediation

phases.objective: Give GPT Admin a repository-owned Staging-only remediation contract for access repair, action-schema drift and execution-policy surface compatibility while preserving exact-SHA handoff, server-issued execution-ticket authority and same-cycle readback before any mutation.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: GPT Admin can plan and repository-dry-run the exact Staging grant repair without a fake migration selection, issue the canonical local Windows handoff, and remain fail-closed until a governed execution-ticket verifier and same-cycle local database readback authorize mutation.
steps: Plan or repository-dry-run without requiring a migration.
Expose the exact Staging grant policy including optional SELECT-only operational surfaces.
Issue local_cli handoff for explicitly approved mutation.
Require a governed server-side execution-ticket verifier before local grant mutation.
assertions: No uncataloged migration is required for grant-only plan or dry-run.
v_platform_capability_gaps is optional SELECT-only and missing-object absence cannot widen privileges.
Mutation remains exact-SHA, execution-ticket, typed-confirmation, local-Windows and readback gated.
The local CLI does not silently fall back to the Production bootstrap grant contract for Staging access repair.
Production, DNS, provider and secrets remain untouched.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Staging-only schema repair can select the exact repository-owned actions metadata migration, while execution-policy authority resolves through an explicit SQL-backed legacy alias only when the canonical key is absent, without widening Production authority or changing the canonical baseline migration chain.
steps: Load the Staging remediation overlay instead of widening the shared Production bootstrap catalog.
Verify the actions metadata remediation migration exists at the exact repository path and matches its pinned SHA-256 and statement count.
Catalog the additive actions metadata reconciliation migration.
When and only when that canonical SQL row is absent, consult the repository-declared legacy SQL authority row surface.execution_policy_sheet.
Fail closed for unknown aliases or a missing legacy authority row.
Require exact-SHA typed approval and execution-ticket verification before apply_migration.
Verify declared schema postconditions in the same cycle.
assertions: The actions repair adds allowed_actor_roles, allowed_governance_levels, oauth_secret_storage_type and oauth_last_validated_at only when absent.
Execution-policy compatibility remains backed by registry_surfaces_catalog rather than an in-memory authority override.
A present canonical surface.execution_policy_registry_sheet row always wins over the legacy alias.
Only the explicitly declared surface.execution_policy_sheet compatibility alias is accepted; unknown aliases remain fail-closed.
No new repair migration is injected into the canonical schema-bundle chain for the surface-key rename.
External Phase B evidence cannot be fabricated by this remediation path.
No Production, provider, Hostinger or Cloudflare mutation is authorized.

blockers: Production, DNS, provider, database mutation and external-evidence fabrication require separate explicit authority.
Genuine Phase B external evidence and countersigning remain a separate live workflow and are not synthesized by this remediation contract.
